interface.longDescription:
Sellfy is a store builder for creators. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your own Sellfy store, so you can run it by asking instead of clicking through the dashboard. It's for store owners managing their own store, and it doesn't sell anything inside ChatGPT.

Once connected, you can:
- Storefront: change your store's colors, fonts, buttons and layout, edit pages and blocks, work on a draft version of your store, publish it, or restore a backup.
- Products: list, create and update products, their files, variants, media, shipping and license keys. New products are created unpublished.
- Orders and customers: search orders and look up customers and reviews, including buyer names and email addresses.
- Sales: summaries, sales over time, and top products, sources and countries.
- Discount codes: create, update and expire them.
- Email campaigns: create and edit drafts and send a test to your own address. Sending to your list stays in the Sellfy dashboard.

It can't delete products or discount codes, issue refunds or move money. You approve the connection once on Sellfy's sign-in screen, and it grants read and write access to your store.
capabilities: Storefront page and content block management
Storefront drafts, previews, publishing and backup restoration
Digital, physical, subscription, freebie and bundle product management
Product files, variants, images and media management
Product shipping settings and shipping profiles
Sales reports, trends and top-performing products
Discounts, coupon codes and promotional offers
Email campaign drafts and test emails
defaultPrompt: How did my sales last week compare with the week before?
Create a digital product called Autumn Presets at 19.99 and keep it unpublished.
Start a new draft of my store, add a page for the course bundle, and give me a preview link.

prompts: How did my sales last week compare with the week before?
Create a digital product called Autumn Presets at 19.99 and keep it unpublished.
Start a new draft of my store, add a page for the course bundle, and give me a preview link.

positive.description: Display the connected seller product catalogue, including prices, links and cover-image availability. Reviewer store should contain products both with and without cover images.
positive.prompt: Show me my products with their prices and links. Which ones have cover images?
positive.tools_triggered: get_store_info, list_products, list_product_media; get_product when product details require expansion
positive.expected_behavior: Read the store currency with get_store_info; list products and inspect media for each returned product. Display names, correctly formatted prices in the store currency, and actual clickable storefront links. Distinguish products with an image thumbnail from those without. Do not invent products, prices, links, or images; account for pagination where relevant.

positive.description: Create a digital product draft with an exact name, description and price; do not publish it. Use a reviewer store without a product of this name or explicitly allow creation of a new test item.
positive.prompt: Create a digital product called “Listening Journal — Demo 01” for 9.99. Description: A simple companion for listening more closely and capturing the moments that stay with you. Choose an album and listen without distractions. Write down three sounds you noticed, the mood they created, and one track you want to revisit.
positive.tools_triggered: get_store_info, create_product, get_product; update_product only if needed to set or verify requested fields
positive.expected_behavior: Read the store currency first. Create one digital product named exactly “Listening Journal — Demo 01” at 9.99 expressed in the store currency minor units, with the exact supplied description. Confirm the returned product ID, details or link using actual tool results. Keep the product unpublished; do not fabricate uploaded content, create duplicates on retries, or publish without the seller requesting it.

positive.description: Create and preview a themed storefront draft, without editing the live storefront. Reviewer store needs an existing product with a usable cover image and module types that support the requested layout.
positive.prompt: Create a storefront draft. Use a light theme with a cream background, colorful accents, and serif headings. Add a split hero with “Find your next favourite sound.”, one of my product covers, and an “Explore the catalogue” button. Add a three-column product grid below it. Give me the preview link.
positive.tools_triggered: create_store_version, get_store_settings, update_store_settings, list_store_pages, get_store_page, list_store_module_types, set_store_module, update_store_page, list_products, list_product_media; list_store_versions when needed
positive.expected_behavior: Create a draft using create_store_version and apply theme/page/block edits using its version_id. Select an actual product cover from list_product_media, set the exact headline, a catalogue link, and a three-column product grid where supported by the module constraints. Use supported settings or explain any unsupported styling detail rather than claiming it was applied. Return the actual preview_url. Do not publish or modify the live storefront.

positive.description: Add a Listening Room page to the draft from the preceding case. Reviewer store must retain that draft and have at least three suitable existing products with covers.
positive.prompt: In the storefront draft, add a “Listening Room” page to the navigation. Show three products with their cover, name, price, short description, and a “View release” button. Alternate the covers left and right. Give me the preview link.
positive.tools_triggered: list_store_versions, list_store_pages, list_store_module_types, set_store_module, create_store_page, get_store_page, update_store_page, list_products, get_product, list_product_media, get_store_info
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the existing draft and use its version_id for every edit. Create the Listening Room page and include it in draft navigation. Display three real products with their returned images, names, currency-correct prices, descriptions and actual product links. Alternate left/right layouts only where supported by available module types; disclose limitations instead of inventing a result. Return the draft preview_url and leave the live storefront unchanged.

positive.description: Publish the reviewed draft from the preceding cases. Requires the same reviewer store, a retained draft, and explicit authorization to alter its live storefront.
positive.tools_triggered: list_store_versions, publish_store_version; get_store_info and list_store_pages when needed to identify or verify the published store
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the draft created in the previous cases; if several drafts are available or the intended version is unclear, ask which one. Explain that publishing replaces the live storefront and obtain confirmation when required. Publish only the selected draft using publish_store_version and report the actual result. Verify live storefront state where tools allow; do not claim publication if the tool fails or a stale revision blocks it.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion of a product. Explain that this MCP does not provide product deletion; do not attempt an alternative destructive action or claim deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete “Listening Journal — Demo 01” from my store.

negative.description: Unsupported sending of an email campaign to the entire subscriber list. Explain that campaign sending must be done in the Sellfy dashboard; do not send any email or create a campaign unless separately requested.
negative.prompt: Email all my subscribers now: “New releases are live — come take a listen.”

negative.description: Unsupported modification of payout settings. Explain that payment processor or payout email settings cannot be changed using the Sellfy MCP tools; do not modify store settings or claim success.
negative.prompt: Change my payout PayPal email to example@sellfy.com.
